Perché le decisioni sugli organici non funzionano

Di solito gli organici si decidono in base a chi insiste di più o ai numeri dell’anno precedente. Nessuno ha misurato i carichi di lavoro, nessuno ha verificato se due ruoli svolgono le stesse attività e la previsione è l’opinione di una sola persona. Così l’azienda assume in fretta, taglia in fretta e paga entrambe le scelte.

Cosa cambia dopo questo corso

Calcoli quante persone servono a un team in base ai carichi di lavoro e al fabbisogno. Fai previsioni con metodi strutturati, senza affidarti a un’unica stima. Individui le duplicazioni tra ruoli e decidi cosa esternalizzare. Colleghi gli organici alle prestazioni e sai dimostrare con i numeri il ritorno di un’iniziativa HR.

Cosa trovi: 85 strumenti, contati lezione per lezione

Non devi fidarti sulla parola. Apri una lezione qualsiasi e leggi la descrizione: ogni strumento presente è elencato per nome.

  • 8 elenchi di domande e tracce: domande per l’analisi storica del personale, domande per l’analisi delle mansioni, domande per il colloquio di uscita, traccia di intervista per la diagnosi organizzativa
  • 7 formule e gruppi di indicatori: indicatori degli equivalenti a tempo pieno (FTE), formula di previsione dell’offerta di personale, ROI del capitale umano, indicatori di turnover e fidelizzazione del personale
  • 6 schede di valutazione e matrici: matrice di valutazione ABCDE dei collaboratori, scala di valutazione delle prestazioni a cinque livelli, matrici dei livelli di competenza
  • 31 modelli e metodi spiegati: analisi dei divari, ampiezza del controllo, previsione del personale basata sulle competenze, analisi degli sprechi Lean, gestione per obiettivi
  • 6 risorse scaricabili: le presentazioni delle lezioni

Dove trovi gli strumenti

Chi ti guida

Sono Mike, il docente HR #1 su Udemy, con 1,800,000+ iscrizioni ai corsi da parte di 170,000 studenti, e autore di circa 200 libri su Amazon. Ho costruito il sistema di gestione del personale di Preply mentre diventava un unicorno e ho lavorato in Wargaming, iDeals e Alfa-Bank nel corso di 20 anni in HR. Possiedo le certificazioni PHRi, SHRM-CP e HCI sHRBP e rappresento HRCI nell’Europa orientale.

Al canale televisivo STB ci siamo accorti che l’organico delle pulizie era sovradimensionato: continuavamo a cercare, formare e inserire addetti. Abbiamo affidato il lavoro a un’impresa di pulizie, riducendo di 100 persone l’organico a libro paga. Esternalizzare ha senso quando l’attività non è centrale per l’azienda e costa lo stesso o dal 20 al 30% in meno, e spesso anche quando costa di più, perché il costo di una persona va oltre lo stipendio. Avevamo anche ruoli con un carico di lavoro pari a metà di un impiego. Abbiamo individuato persone all’interno dell’azienda e proposto di accorpare i ruoli, con un compenso aggiuntivo quando il carico aumentava davvero. Con 30 progetti televisivi, ciascuno un prodotto a sé, le possibilità di accorpamento erano molte.

Why 360 assessments go wrong

The questionnaire asks about qualities nobody can observe. People are told it is anonymous and then guess who wrote what. Managers receive a report with forty numbers and no idea what to do next. One bad cycle is enough for the company to stop trusting the method. Each of these has a known cause: the wording of the questions, the choice of raters, the way results are delivered.

What changes after this course

You write questions about behavior people can see. You choose raters and explain the rules so that people answer honestly. You deliver a report a person can read in ten minutes and discuss in one meeting. The result becomes a development plan, not a verdict. And you connect the assessment to the competency model, appraisal and performance reviews, so it is part of the system and not a separate event.

Who is teaching

Se dibuja un nuevo organigrama, se redistribuye a las personas y, seis meses después, vuelven los mismos problemas. Por qué las reorganizaciones decepcionan

La estructura se elige antes de analizar la estrategia y el trabajo. Se asignan automáticamente nuevos roles al personal actual, las responsabilidades de decisión siguen sin estar claras y la matriz se convierte en dos jefes que quieren tener el control. El cambio se anuncia en lugar de planificarse, así que la organización vuelve a sus viejos hábitos.

A pitch deck is a concise and visually engaging presentation that is typically used in business settings to convey a company's or project's key information, value proposition, and investment opportunity. Pitch decks are primarily used when seeking investments, partnerships, or to secure new clients. They serve as a persuasive tool to convey the essence of your business or idea quickly and effectively. A well-crafted pitch deck can make a significant difference in the success of a business, startup, or project.

Here are the key components and the needs of usage for a pitch deck in a business context:

  1. Introduction: Start with a compelling introduction that grabs the audience's attention and provides an overview of your business or project.

  2. Problem Statement: Clearly define the problem or need that your product or service addresses. This sets the stage for why your business is relevant.

  3. Solution: Present your solution and how it addresses the identified problem. Explain how your product or service works and what makes it unique.

  4. Market Opportunity: Describe the market size and potential for your business. This includes the target audience and its demographics.

  5. Business Model: Explain how your business will generate revenue, your pricing strategy, and the sales channels you plan to use.

  6. Traction: Showcase any significant achievements, customer testimonials, or partnerships to build credibility.

  7. Competitive Analysis: Identify your competitors and explain how your business is positioned relative to them. Highlight your competitive advantages.

  8. Team: Introduce your team and their relevant experience. This builds trust and confidence in your ability to execute the business plan.

  9. Financial Projections: Present your financial forecasts, including revenue, expenses, and profitability projections. This demonstrates the potential for a return on investment.

  10. Ask: Clearly state what you are seeking from your audience, whether it's investment, partnership, or something else.


The skills related to pitching, business presenting, and business communication are important for experts and companies for several reasons:

  1. Securing Funding: Effective pitching skills are crucial when seeking investments or funding. A well-presented pitch deck can significantly increase the chances of attracting investors.

  2. Building Credibility: Strong presentation skills can help a company or individual build credibility with clients, partners, and stakeholders. A professional presentation conveys competence and confidence.

  3. Effective Communication: Business communication skills are essential for conveying ideas, plans, and strategies within a company. Clear and persuasive communication can drive team alignment and enhance productivity.

  4. Client Acquisition: In sales and client-facing roles, effective presentation and communication skills can help in acquiring new clients or customers. It can make the difference between a successful pitch and a missed opportunity.

  5. Career Advancement: For individuals, mastering these skills can lead to career advancement. Professionals who can effectively communicate their ideas and lead presentations tend to stand out and progress in their careers.

  6. Team Collaboration: Effective communication and presentation skills are essential for collaboration within teams. They help in conveying objectives, sharing updates, and ensuring everyone is on the same page.


Strong understanding of pitching, business presenting skills, and business communication skills is crucial in today's competitive business environment. These skills not only enable companies to attract investments, win clients, and build credibility but also support the career growth of individuals. A combination of these skills can lead to more successful and impactful business endeavors.
